kicker.zh: 开发中 · 车载总线与诊断
kicker.en: In development · In-vehicle bus and diagnostics

lede.zh: 车上的几十个控制器共用一根线说话。从"每一拍线上有一位"开始，亲手搭出听懂它们的探针，再一步步长成能读故障码、能刷写软件的诊断仪。
lede.en: The dozens of controllers in a car talk over one shared line. Starting from “one bit on the line each tick”, build a probe that understands them, and grow it step by step into a tester that reads fault codes and reflashes software.

question.zh: 插上总线，上面在说什么？
question.en: Plugged into the bus: what is being said on it?

t.zh: 车上的控制器共用一根<wiki-ref to="bus"></wiki-ref>。这一章你造的是一个只听不说的探针：插上总线，弄清楚上面在说什么。
t.en: The controllers in a car share one <wiki-ref to="bus"></wiki-ref>. In this chapter you build a probe that only listens: plug it into the bus and work out what is being said on it.

t.zh: 探针每一拍跑一遍你的板。板左边的总线元件给出这一拍线上的那一位：0 是<wiki-ref to="dominant"></wiki-ref>，1 是<wiki-ref to="recessive"></wiki-ref>。运行就是时间：下面的波形一拍一格往前走。
t.en: The probe runs your board once a tick. The bus part on its left gives this tick’s bit on the line: 0 is <wiki-ref to="dominant"></wiki-ref>, 1 is <wiki-ref to="recessive"></wiki-ref>. Running is time: the waveform below moves on one tick a cell.

after.zh: 板每一拍从头跑一遍，只看得到这一拍。没人说话时线一直是隐性；一帧开始，线上才有了显性。
after.en: The board runs afresh each tick and sees only that tick. With nobody talking the line stays recessive; once a frame starts, dominant bits appear.

brief.zh: 每一拍，把总线上的那一位原样交出去。
brief.en: Every tick, give out the bit on the bus as it is.

hint.zh: 把左边的总线元件接到右边的输出上。
hint.en: Wire the bus part on the left into the output on the right.

t.zh: 板每一拍从头跑，上一拍的东西它一样也记不住。可总线上的一位只有和前后连起来看才有意思。
t.en: The board starts afresh each tick and remembers nothing of the last one. Yet a bit on the bus only means something next to the bits around it.

t.zh: 探针多了一种能力：<wiki-ref to="register"></wiki-ref>。<part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref>把这一拍接到它上面的值存起来，下一拍<part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref>把它读出来；名字相同的两个元件说的是同一张寄存卡。读的那个可以设一个初值：还没存过东西时读出它。
t.en: The probe gains one ability: <wiki-ref to="register"></wiki-ref>s. <part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref> stores the value wired into it this tick, and <part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref> reads it back on the next one; two parts with the same name are the same register. The reading one has a start value: what it reads before anything is kept.

after.zh: 寄存卡把一拍和下一拍连了起来：从现在起，板能记事了。
after.en: A register ties one tick to the next: from now on the board can remember.

brief.zh: 每一拍交出总线上一拍的那一位；第一拍交出 1。
brief.en: Every tick, give out the bit the bus had the tick before; 1 on the first tick.

hint.zh: 这一拍的总线存起来，下一拍读出来交出去。
hint.en: Keep the bus this tick, and give out what you read next tick.

t.zh: 能记住上一拍以后，就能看出线什么时候变了。新元件<part-ref to="part:compare"></part-ref>：两个值相等时给出「是」，不相等给出「否」；它还有一种形状「小于」。
t.en: Remembering the last tick, the board can tell when the line changes. A new part, <part-ref to="part:compare"></part-ref>: yes when its two values are equal, no when they are not; it has a second form, Less than.

after.zh: 一张寄存卡加一个比较，板就看得出线在哪一拍变了。
after.en: A register and a comparison, and the board can see the tick the line changes.

brief.zh: 每一拍回答：总线这一拍的位和上一拍一样吗？第一拍拿它和 1 比。
brief.en: Every tick, answer: is the bit on the bus the same as the tick before? On the first tick, compare it with 1.

t.zh: 要知道一位落在一帧的哪里，得会数。寄存卡记得住一个数，还缺一样把它往上加的东西。
t.en: To know where a bit falls in a frame, the board has to count. A register can hold a number; what is missing is something to add to it.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:arith"></part-ref>：形状「加一」给出输入加 1，「相加」给出两个输入的和。
t.en: A new part, <part-ref to="part:arith"></part-ref>: its form Add one gives its input plus 1, and Add gives the sum of its two inputs.

after.zh: 读出、加一、存回去：一个绕过寄存卡的小圈，每拍转一次，就是计数。
after.en: Read, add one, keep it: a small loop through a register, once round each tick, is a count.

brief.zh: 每一拍交出这是第几拍：第一拍是 0。
brief.en: Every tick, give out which tick this is: the first is 0.

t.zh: 探针刚插上时不知道总线正说到哪里，要先等一阵。等多久是一个定好的数，板上还没有能写下一个数的元件。
t.en: A probe just plugged in does not know where the bus is in what it is saying, so it waits a while first. How long is a fixed number, and the board has no part yet that holds a number.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>：总是给出它设的那个数。
t.en: A new part, <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>: always gives the number it is set to.

after.zh: 计数加上一个比较，就是"等到第几拍"。
after.en: A count and a comparison make “wait until tick so-and-so”.

brief.zh: 从第 11 拍（从 0 数起）开始一直回答「是」，在那之前回答「否」。
brief.en: Answer yes from tick 11 on (counting from 0), and no before it.

t.zh: 数拍只会一直往上数。要数"连着多少拍"，得在断的那一拍把数清零：板要能在两个值里挑一个。
t.en: Counting ticks only goes up. To count “how many in a row”, the count has to go back to zero on the tick the run breaks: the board has to pick one of two values.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref>：条件是「是」或 1 时给出「是」那一路，「否」或 0 时给出「否」那一路；没接的一路读作「—」。
t.en: A new part, <part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref>: when its condition is yes or 1 it gives its Yes input, when it is no or 0 its No input; an input left open reads 「—」.

desc.zh: 交出「接着数」在这一拍之前连着是 1 的拍数；「接着数」为 0 的那一拍过后从 0 重数。每一块计数器有自己的寄存卡。
desc.en: Gives how many ticks in a row Go on was 1 before this tick; after a tick where Go on is 0 it counts from 0 again. Each counter has registers of its own.

after.zh: 这块板现在是一个元件了，板上放几块，就各数各的。
after.en: This board is now a part, and several of them on one board each keep their own count.

brief.zh: 每一拍交出「接着数」在这一拍之前连着是 1 的拍数；它一是 0，就从 0 重数。
brief.en: Every tick, give out how many ticks in a row Go on was 1 before this one; once it is 0, start again from 0.

t.zh: 没人说话时总线一直是隐性。一个控制器开口，先说一位显性：这一位叫<wiki-ref to="sof"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: With nobody talking the bus stays recessive. A controller that starts talking first says one dominant bit: the <wiki-ref to="sof"></wiki-ref>.

t.zh: 可一帧里面到处都有显性。只有在总线确实安静过一阵以后的那个显性，才是一帧的开头。
t.en: Yet a frame is full of dominant bits. Only the dominant bit after the bus has really been quiet for a while is where a frame begins.

after.zh: 一帧的最后是 11 位隐性：应答界定位、7 位帧结束、3 位帧间间隔。所以两帧紧挨着时，这条规则照样认得出下一帧。
after.en: A frame ends with 11 recessive bits: the ACK delimiter, 7 bits of end of frame and 3 of intermission. So even with frames back to back, this rule still finds the next one.

brief.zh: 总线连着至少 11 拍隐性之后的第一个显性，回答「是」；其余每一拍回答「否」。
brief.en: Answer yes on the first dominant bit after at least 11 recessive ones in a row, and no on every other tick.

hint.zh: 数出这一拍之前隐性连着多长。
hint.en: Count how long the recessive run before this tick is.

hint.zh: 显性是 0，可以拿它和常数 0 比。
hint.en: Dominant is 0, and can be compared with a constant 0.

t.zh: 总线上的数是一位一位到的：说话的控制器先说最高位。探针要把它们攒回一个数。
t.en: Numbers come over the bus a bit at a time, the highest bit first. The probe has to gather them back into a number.

t.zh: 攒下的数后面多接一位，它在二进制里整体左移了一格，再加上新来的那一位。
t.en: Putting one more bit after the number gathered so far shifts it one place left in binary, then adds the new bit.

desc.zh: 「接着攒」为 1 时，把「位」接到攒下的数末尾，交出新的数；为 0 时交出 0 并清空。每一块有自己的寄存卡。
desc.en: When Go on is 1, puts Bit at the end of the number gathered and gives the new number; when it is 0, gives 0 and empties. Each one has registers of its own.

after.zh: 一个数加上自己，就是左移一格；再加上新的一位，就接上了。
after.en: A number added to itself is shifted one place left; add the new bit and it is on the end.

brief.zh: 「接着攒」为 1 的每一拍，把「位」接到已经攒下的数的末尾（先来的位在高位），交出攒到的数；为 0 的那一拍交出 0，从头再攒。
brief.en: On every tick Go on is 1, put Bit at the end of the number gathered so far (the first bit highest) and give out the number; on a tick it is 0, give out 0 and start over.

t.zh: 认得出一帧从哪开始，也会把位攒成数，探针就能读出第一样东西：这一帧是哪条消息。每一帧开头是 11 位的<wiki-ref to="identifier"></wiki-ref>，说的是这条消息是什么、有多要紧。
t.en: Knowing where a frame starts and how to gather bits into a number, the probe can read the first thing: which message this frame is. Every frame begins with an 11-bit <wiki-ref to="identifier"></wiki-ref>, which says what the message is and how urgent.

t.zh: 一个帧起始只亮一拍，可之后的 11 拍都要知道"我在一帧里面"。
t.en: A start of frame lights for one tick, yet the 11 ticks after it all need to know “I am inside a frame”.

after.zh: 两块计数器各数各的：一块数总线安静了多久，一块数进帧以后过了几拍。
after.en: The two counters count on their own: one how long the bus was quiet, one how many ticks since the frame began.

brief.zh: 帧起始后面的 11 位是这一帧的标识符。在它最后一位到达的那一拍交出标识符，其余每一拍交出「—」。
brief.en: The 11 bits after the start of frame are the frame’s identifier. Give it out on the tick its last bit arrives, and 「—」 on every other tick.

hint.zh: 帧起始那一拍，在寄存卡里记下"进帧了"，之后一直记着。
hint.en: On the start of frame, keep “in a frame” in a register, and keep it there.

hint.zh: 进帧以后的拍数，用一块<part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>数。
hint.en: Count the ticks since then with a <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>.

body.zh: 车上几十个控制器共用的一对线。这里讲的是 CAN 总线（ISO 11898-1）：任何时候线上只有一位，每个控制器都看得见，也都能说。
body.en: The pair of wires the dozens of controllers in a car share. The one here is the CAN bus (ISO 11898-1): at any moment there is one bit on the line, every controller sees it, and any of them can speak.

body.zh: 真实的总线上是两根线之间的电压差；游戏从"每一拍线上有一位"讲起，不讲电压、终端电阻和位定时。
body.en: On a real bus the bit is a voltage difference between two wires; the game starts from “one bit on the line each tick”, without voltages, terminating resistors or bit timing.

body.zh: 总线上的 0。只要有一个控制器说显性，整根线就是显性：它压过隐性。
body.en: A 0 on the bus. If any one controller says dominant, the whole line is dominant: it wins over recessive.

body.zh: 总线上的 1。只有所有控制器都说隐性（或者都不说话）时，线才是隐性。没人说话的总线一直是隐性。
body.en: A 1 on the bus. The line is recessive only when every controller says recessive (or none says anything). A bus nobody is talking on stays recessive.

body.zh: 探针每一拍把板从头跑一遍。寄存卡是板上唯一能跨过一拍的东西：这一拍存进去的值，下一拍读得出来。
body.en: The probe runs the board afresh each tick. A register is the one thing on it that lasts from one tick to the next: what is kept in it this tick can be read on the next.

body.zh: 一帧的第一位，一位显性。只有在总线连着安静了至少 11 位之后，控制器才能开口，所以安静之后的第一个显性就是帧起始。
body.en: The first bit of a frame, one dominant bit. A controller may only start talking once the bus has been quiet for at least 11 bits, so the first dominant bit after that quiet is a start of frame.

body.zh: 帧起始后面的 11 位，高位在前。它说的是这条消息是什么（车速、门开没开……），而不是谁发的；一条消息只有一个控制器发。
body.en: The 11 bits after the start of frame, highest first. It says what the message is (the speed, whether a door is open…), not who sent it; each message is sent by one controller.

body.zh: 真实的 CAN 还有 29 位的扩展标识符，游戏只用 11 位的。
body.en: Real CAN also has 29-bit extended identifiers; the game uses the 11-bit ones only.
